thread:
Alex W: Heads-up — we saw two recurring tail-latency spikes on the API path /v1/generate yesterday 11:10–11:42 UTC. p95 stayed ok but p99 burned ~9% of the monthly error budget. Thinking we need an SLO re-eval, a short SLA recalibration note for customers, and a recurring-incident dashboard to spot the pattern. Quick summary below.

Maria S: Can you share the exact metrics and the query? prod or dedicated?

Alex W: Prod (hosted). Traffic was mixed; ~60rps avg to that route during window, bursts to 120rps. Datadog query I used:
```
avg(last_5m):percentile(99, request.duration{env:prod,route:/v1/generate}) by {region}
```
p99 spiked to ~1.8s (baseline ~420ms). Error-rate stayed <0.1% but tail latency is the concern.

Maria S: Ok that matches the alert. Did we see corresponding GPU queueing on Dedicated pools or any autoscaler churn?

Alex W: No autoscaler events. Kernel-level queueing logs show KV cache misses spiked for models with long contexts. Attached a small snippet from runtime logs: 
```
[11:15:23] warn: kv_cache_miss_rate=0.42; batch_size=8; seq_len=2048
[11:16:00] info: routing=fallback->quantized-variant; latency_incr=380ms
```

Devon K: I'll take the dashboard work. Plan: 1) p99/p95 trend panel last 30d, 2) KV cache miss rate overlay, 3) routing fallback count, 4) heatmap by region/time. Will also add an annotation layer for incidents. ETA: Tue 03/31 EOD.

Priya R: I'll own the SLO proposal. Current SLO for this route is p99 < 500ms with a 99.5% target. Given reality, propose interim adjustment to p99 < 800ms while we fix runtime caching and routing. Also propose adding a secondary objective: p99 tail for large seq_len (>1024) separate SLI. Draft by Fri 03/27.

Alex W: Sounds reasonable. We should also add explicit error-budget burn alert at 5%/day so we get earlier signals.

sre-bot: Incident ticket created INC-2026-0423 by Alex W referencing this thread.

Maria S: +1 to the seq_len split. If we separate SLIs we can route long-context requests to dedicated pools with relaxed SLOs. That will be a policy change + cost impact, will need Product sign-off.

Devon K: For the dashboard I'll surface the cost delta per route when we propose routing policy. Need pricing mapper from Product/Fin to estimate.

Priya R: I'll draft the SLO doc with two options: (A) tighten infra fixes and keep current SLO with remediation timeline, (B) pragmatic SLO split + customer notice. Will include rollback criteria and owner assignments.

Alex W: Action items recap: 
- Devon K: Dashboard + annotations (eng-sre) — due 2026-03-31T23:59Z
- Priya R: SLO proposal + customer-facing SLA note draft — due 2026-03-27T17:00Z
- Alex W: Update the runbook with new KV cache troubleshooting steps and add an escalation path to runtime team — due 2026-03-26
- Maria S: Coordinate with Product on routing policy cost/impact and get sign-off — due 2026-04-02
- Ops: Add error-budget burn alert at 5%/day (owner: eng-oncall) — request tracked in INC-2026-0423

Priya R: I'll also add regression test prompts to Redwood Optimize evals to detect quality regressions if we change quantized variants.

Devon K: Noted. I'll create the dashboard in the shared grafana/eng-sre folder and link it to the incident ticket.

Alex W: Let's triage this in the sync Wed 03/25 10:30 UTC — short 20m follow-up to review Priya's proposal and Devon's first dashboard draft.

Maria S: @Devon K @Priya R thanks — can you drop status in the incident ticket as PRs land? I'll watch the error budget. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance note: no model rollouts allowed until remediation triage completes.

Alex W: Thanks everyone. If anyone sees repeated bursts overnight, ping me directly.

Priya R: ACK, will post SLO draft and link it here when ready.

Devon K: ACK — starting dashboard work today.

Alex W: End of thread.
